note: Grandson; initial stress, confirmed independently of adjacent Shina acute.
Man; unmarked central-vowel sequence. Footnote2 explicitly says same words for son and man were provided by two separate speakers; this polysemy is not an extraction error.
Mother; initial stress in a vowel sequence.
Maternal uncle; one initial stress mark, not two.
Mother-in-law; unmarked.
Name; nasalized doubled u, not stored nto. No stress marked.
Person; unmarked. Exact central/rounded u quality remains approximate; Shina columns are manuẓo-type, not ridgepole.
Sister; initial stress. Same lexical form also in brother's-wife alternatives.
Son; same form as man, confirmed by source footnote2. Unmarked central vowel sequence.
Son-in-law; final stress.
Wife's brother; final stress; stored extra z/ẓ sequence is not printed.
Woman; two comma-separated alternatives, second also daughter. Do not treat as one phrase.
Arrow; unmarked Purik loan.
Ashes; final stress, Purik loan.
Bed; final stress, source proposes Kashmiri loan.
Bread; medial stress in three-syllable reading.
Churn; medial stress, source identifies Burushaski loan.
Curds; unmarked long vowel.
Dream; initial stress; source explicitly adds pl.? Final ii may be plural and must not be equated with ordinary final i nouns.
Fertilizer; unmarked, final š rather than stored s; exact u quality approximate.
Field; two alternatives, kheey identified as an Indo-Aryan loan. Exact rounded/central vowel of bun approximate.
Fire; unmarked long vowel.
Ghee; palatalized g and long ii, unmarked. Stored gi loses length/palatalization.
Grease; final velar nasal visible, no accent. Distinct from sunny-slope form read separately.
Handspan; retroflex/underlined initial and final stops, unmarked.
Honey; palatalized g and nasal long aa before stressed tsi. Source discussion's gliiitsi spelling differs; preserve table reading for stress, with exact nasal-vowel quality uncertain.
House; long oo and retroflex final, NO acute or stress mark in Brokskat cell.
Irrigation channel; two alternatives. Stored gia is palatalized g, and second form has no initial i vowel.
Loom; final stress, Purik loan.
Mattock; final stress.
Milk; stressed džen with preceding reduced/central vowel. Precise initial glyph approximate, stress position clear.
Path; unmarked.
Plough; unmarked.
Roof; initial stress despite long final aa.
Salt; final stress; printed final doubled barred/central u normalized as uu. Not stored yue.
Sickle; final stress.
Smoke; unmarked doubled barred/central u normalized as uu. Stored dre is an extraction error, enabling comparison with dhūma after final m loss.
Spinning wheel; unmarked.
Village; unmarked barred/central u approximate. Same spelling as field in table, distinct from first-person plural reading.
Wood; initial/only-syllable stress with long oo.
Work; unmarked.
Blue sky; Brokskat dash, no attestation.

Cloud; the printed initial a has an acute-looking mark as well as a pre-second-syllable apostrophe. Treat this as an anomalous source marking, not a normal mora or clean single-stress datum, pending higher-resolution/source clarification.
Lightning; unmarked Purik loan.
Moon; palatalized g, unmarked.
Rain; final stress, rounded/central final u approximate, Purik loan.
Sky; final stress.
Snow; initial stress, retroflex sibilant visible; strengthens lexical comparison with abhra/aẓo rain but semantic transfer still requires assessment.
Star; initial stress.
Sun; initial stress, barred/central u normalized as u; stored sari misreads vowel.
Water; doubled central vowel, unmarked.
Wind; long y vowel and final š, unmarked.
